resources.string: Choose a file with Android. You can cancel and return to your draft.
The key stays on this device and is sent to the configured API. The connection test sends a short request that may count against your model limit.
The floating panel hides on the lock screen.
On POCO, Xiaomi, and Redmi, allow background pop-ups. If the panel disappears, select No restrictions for Axis in battery settings.
One command per line: click Label, type Text, read, down, up, back.
Open a UTF-8 TXT or Markdown file up to 128 KB. Save changes to a separate copy.
Open Axis app settings in Android
The panel is shown over apps
The panel detects the phrase on your device while the screen is unlocked. Close the panel to stop listening.
Axis previews each step before running it. Typing replaces the focused text. Taps may change data in the app.
Drag the sphere or the expanded panel header to move it.
Drag the sphere or the expanded panel header.
Use a server with OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions over HTTPS.
With gesture navigation, swipe inward from a bottom corner. If your phone uses a different shortcut, use the Android shortcut or the Axis tile.
For screen commands, Axis sends the visible element labels to your selected model. The model can tap, type, and scroll as requested. Use Stop request to interrupt it.
Changing the address clears this profile history and requires a new key.
Leave this blank to keep the current key for this address.
The Android speech service may use the network. Review and edit the transcript before sending.
Say or type Open Settings and go to About phone. This example uses a built-in Android shortcut.
The service shows the panel over apps and reads accessible screen elements for your commands. Axis sends screen data to the model for screen commands and automatic actions.
The Android speech service can use the network. Select reply voices in Models.
Axis can read accessible controls and tap them. It follows your steps in the selected app. Screen text is shown on this device. Disable the service in Android settings.
This clears the selected conversation on this device.
Download the model for your wake phrase language (about 40–45 MB).
Could not download the model. Check your connection and available storage.
Listening. Say “Hey Axis” followed by your command.
Open the floating panel or start listening.
Listening is unavailable. Check microphone access.
The API returned an empty catalog. Enter the model ID manually.
Axis starts recording when you open the voice overlay on an unlocked screen. If auto-send is on, Axis sends the recognized phrase after a pause.
Axis carries out your command in order. Configure tools separately for each model.
Axis sends the names of available controls and your command to the selected model.
Axis sends the app name and goal to the model.
Gemini receives the reply text in a separate speech request.
